lines.text: There's sunken treasure in GTA 6. Here's how to unlock it.
Finish Island Dreams, the Chapter 1 shipwreck mission for Kenton.
Equip your scuba gear and metal detector, and dive the wrecks he sends you.
Follow the detector until it beeps, then sell your finds back to Kenton.
Found any yet? Follow for more GTA 6 tips.
